1.consolidated_definition: Dícese peyorativamente de la persona metida en sociedad por haber hecho fortuna. También dicen nuevo rico.
1.en_consolidated_definition: This term is used pejoratively to describe a person who has become part of high society due to having made a fortune. Also referred to as "nuevo rico".
